About Me

I joined ByteDance as a research scientist in 2025 and currently focus on developing the Seedance Mini and Seedance Flash model families. I received my Ph.D. in Computer Science from the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, where I conducted my doctoral research at the National Laboratory of Pattern Recognition under the supervision of Prof. Changsheng Xu and Prof. Weiming Dong. Prior to that, I earned my B.S. in Automation from Tsinghua University in 2020.

My research focuses on Video and Image generation, with an emphasis on training Diffusion Transformers, mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures and vision-language models (VLMs).
